Closing review: the work is complete but one criterion is contradicted by the shipped behaviour, so this moves `in_progress` -> `in_review` rather than to `done`. Nothing ticked; the story owner has to arbitrate the criterion.

**Fails — "No secret appears in the generated file."** The companion bearer token is written literally into the repository: `cmd/gintrack/agent.go:193-196` sets `BearerHeader = "Bearer " + res.Config.Server.Token` and `templates/agent/pando.toml.tmpl:88-90` emits `Authorization = {{ toml .BearerHeader }}` into `.pando.toml` at the repository root. The test asserts exactly that (`cmd/gintrack/agent_test.go:55`: `"Authorization = 'Bearer companion-secret'"`). The reason is real and is recorded on this task and in ADR-035 (Pando does not expand environment variables in MCP `Headers`, and `.pando.toml` must sit in `agui-serve --cwd`), and the mitigations are implemented: mode 0600 re-applied with an explicit chmod (`agent.go:230-236`), the SECURITY banner (`pando.toml.tmpl:10-14`), the stdout warning (`agent.go:270-272`), and the token kept out of the persona, the skill, stdout and the AG-UI token file (`agent_test.go:112-136`, :305-340). But as written the criterion is not met.

Smallest fix, either: (a) have `agent init` append `.pando.toml` to `.git/info/exclude` when it is not already ignored, so the secret cannot be committed even by accident, and re-word the criterion to "no secret outside a 0600, git-ignored file"; or (b) drop the header and document the manual paste, which costs the working MCP wiring.

Met: writes into a temp directory and prints the next step -> `agent.go:219-247`, :263-289, `TestAgentInitWritesThePandoConfiguration`; re-run without `--force` exits non-zero, changes nothing, names the file -> `agent.go:207-218` (`exitConflict`), `TestAgentInitRefusesToOverwrite`; test coverage of generation, `--force` and the refusal -> `go test -race -count=1 -run Agent ./cmd/gintrack/` green (9 tests incl. `TestAgentInitForceOverwrites`, `TestAgentInitWithoutACompanionToken`, `TestAgentCompanionURL`, `TestAgentTokenFileIsStableAndPrivate`).
